key_fields.name: CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU
key_fields.meaning: Exit message 'Thank you for using CardDemo application...'.

key_fields.name: CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY
key_fields.meaning: Message 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

observations.text: COACTUPC copies CSMSG01Y but references neither message; invalid keys are silently treated as Enter (app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:914-916).

purpose: Defines CCDA-COMMON-MESSAGES, two 50-byte common message literals (thank-you and invalid-key) shared by CardDemo online programs. COACTUPC copies it but does not use either message.
